narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>For the ten thousand in the first number, draw ten lotuses.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Ten lotuses make exactly one finger.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>No symbol is ever drawn ten times, because ten of one symbol become the next symbol.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows ten lotuses in a row for 10000; ten lotuses merge into one finger; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, add up the values of the symbols you drew.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Seven fingers, seven coils and seven strokes give seventy thousand, seven hundred and seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Make sure that no symbol appears ten or more times in any numeral.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; check lines appear: add the values of the symbols; no symbol ten times

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu wants to draw ten lotuses for ten thousand. Ten lotuses make one finger, so a symbol is never drawn ten times.
